title: Mission feature (single item from features.json)
description: Schema for an individual feature specification within a mission backlog. Aligned with Factory Droid alignment-training-spec v1.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this feature

description.description: Detailed specification of what the feature must do

skillName.description: Worker skill type to dispatch (e.g., rust-worker, developer, qa)

preconditions.description: Dependency declarations forming a DAG — other feature IDs or environment predicates

expectedBehavior.description: Behavioral acceptance criteria that must be true when feature is complete

verificationSteps.description: Commands to run to verify the feature works (e.g., test commands)

fulfills.description: VAL-* assertion IDs this feature proves when completed

status.description: Current lifecycle state of this feature

workerSessionIds.description: All worker session UUIDs that have touched this feature

currentWorkerSessionId.description: Currently active worker session UUID, or null if idle

completedWorkerSessionId.description: Worker session UUID that completed this feature, or null

retryCount.description: Number of times this feature has been retried after failure
